title: Program circuit size bound
statement: For any natural numbers $n,m,w$, any finite type of instruction kinds, any function assigning to each kind a Boolean-list function, any program of instructions, and any indices $i,j$, the size of the circuit built from the program with output indices $i,j$ is at most $n+2$ plus the program length multiplied by the maximum gadget width among all instruction kinds.
hypotheses_covered: the type of instruction kinds is finite
